turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Taylor calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Chase Mcdonald?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. And is your mailing address still the same?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, same address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me just pull up your account. One please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for waiting, I have it here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $546.00.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My budget has been really tight lately.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that up I'll need a quick look at your monthly budget. What are your main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: rent, groceries and the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship team will follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay $546 the 3rd.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $546.00 on July 3. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any other questions for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I think that's it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
